name: Self-employed, CHF 120,000 net business income, Bellinzona
workings: Net income from self-employment 150,000.00 − 30,000.00 = 120,000.00; AHV/IV/EO at the full 10% (above 60,500) = 12,000.00. No ALV, no BVG.
Largest 3a contribution without a pension fund: 20% × (120,000.00 − 12,000.00) = 21,600.00; 21,600.00 paid, all deductible. Insurance premiums at the amount with pension contributions.
Ticino net income 108,000.00 − 21,600.00 − 5,500.00 = 80,900.00; deduction for single people 0.00; taxable 80,900.00.
Simple tax 6,513.2380; cantonal 100% = 6,513.2380; communal (Bellinzona, 93%) = 6,057.3113; personal tax 40.
No flat professional expenses: business costs are deducted at their real amount, already in the 120,000.00.
